tasks.label: Markdown build
tasks.command: output="${fileDirname}/../${fileDirnameBasename}.md"; files=$(find "${fileDirname}" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.md' -print); if [ -n "$files" ]; then find "${fileDirname}" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.md' | sort | while read -r file; do cat "$file"; echo ""; done > "$output"; fi
